rationale: The agent performed order-changing writes (returns on two orders and a pending-item modification) without any visible user confirmation step, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before executing changes. There’s no evidence of proper user authentication beyond looking up by email and fetching user details. Additionally, the user requested to update the shipping address to their default Chicago home, but no address-update action/tool call is present. While returns and an item color change appear to have been attempted, the absence of confirmation and the missing address change mean the request was not completed in line with policy. The tracking-number request for a canceled order should result in explaining that no tracking exists; there’s no clear evidence that correct final info was provided on that point either.
